limitations: Post hoc: these two configurations were selected after main-study format and length failures were observed.
Artificial sentences only; no main, historical, demonstration or reference labels enter inference.
The same artificial pair is repeated under ten distinct IDs; n=1 is the identical first item, so lexical composition is held constant.
Copy targets are arbitrary serialization targets, not linguistic gold. No answer quality, rhyme accuracy or main-study performance is assessed.
This bounded probe does not reproduce original task difficulty or isolate hidden reasoning; provider time and unseeded serving can vary.

All 24 planned diagnostic jobs and failed/unknown outcomes remain reported. Prespecified budget stops are separate unobserved outcomes, not model behavior. Results never replace main-study outcomes or change its settings.
The larger cap is a prespecified post hoc configuration sensitivity arm, not retrospective validation of the main 8192-token setting.
Caps run in fixed sequential phases (8192 before32768), so cap comparisons may also reflect time or serving variation; two repetitions are descriptive only.
reporting: Deterministic format, exact-ID coverage, visible-text presence, row counts, finish reasons and nullable native resource counters only; no label-quality scores or hypothesis tests
usage_note: Nullable native counters only; reasoning/cached counters are subsets, not additional tokens. No missing counter or cost is imputed as zero. Recorded attempts need not prove remote dispatch.
